narrative: The tiring-house, a little before two. The gown for Gaunt is the one he already wears for that man. The plot on the peg is the cut plot. No leaf from the chest is in the gown or on the peg. He is where Gaunt is not yet done. The yard is in. The book-keeper's plot has not grown a page. The chest at the side of the pegs is shut.
